主题：RE: Influencer outreach - a few notes
Hey,

Quick notes on the influencer list:

1. Please re-contact Lifestyle Maven even though we already reached out - we just finalized updated campaign terms with better rev share that she'd want to hear about.

2. I noticed Dev Streamer is still on the list - check the notes column, they have a competitor exclusivity deal. Don't waste time there.

3. For Cloud Architect - that one's tricky. Great audience but LinkedIn-only creators don't tend to drive the engagement we need for this campaign. Skip for now.

Thanks!
Jenna"}
